verdict.rationale: The evidence documents dashboards and alert rules only as product features. The web API is described as managing organizations, teams and data, and the CLI as handling debug files and source maps. Nothing documents defining dashboards or alerts via JSON models, Terraform, or API endpoints for repeatable provisioning, so the general API is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
